svg.title: Bend Emblem — 1912 historical reconstruction (1912-white)
svg.desc: Historical reconstruction of the Bend Emblem as printed in the Bend Bulletin of 3 July 1912, traced from that page at the scan's native resolution. The double ring, the hand-cut letterforms and the narrow channels are the specimen's own. Newsprint dust is removed; the small central copyright symbol the specimen carries is deliberately not reproduced.
